content:
The image shows a mango leaf that is largely brown/tan and desiccated, with the tip/base area showing some green remnants. The leaf appears withered and curled. There are no black sooty encrustations (ruling out Sooty_Mould), no white powdery coating (ruling out Powdery_Mildew), and no distinct sunken brown/black spots with halos characteristic of Anthracnose.

The leaf shows browning and withering from the base/twig outward, with curling — consistent with Die_Back, which describes leaves curling upwards and falling off, twigs withering from base outward, and bark discoloration.
